evidence.no_api: Shutter cannot read this receiving system. These checks come from the failed message and Shutter's records, and don't show what the receiver holds now.
evidence.unreadable: Shutter could not read this encounter at the receiver. These checks come from the failed message and Shutter's records, and don't show what the receiver holds now.
evidence.documents: Shutter cannot read this receiver's documents or reports. These checks come from the failed message and Shutter's records, and don't show what the receiver holds now.
evidence.read: The receiver evidence below was read at {at}. It may have changed since then.

queue: Before correcting anything: check whether the original message is still queued, retrying or awaiting an application acknowledgement. It may still arrive.
report: Put what you find in the reason when you mark the case handled. That stays a person's report: it isn't verified and doesn't authorise a resend.
asked_note: A later valid change may mean that this is no longer the correct current state.
several_items: This message contains more than one report or document item. Check the original message and each item; this card does not establish that all were filed.
other_message: This card has no specific check for this message type. Check the original in the source's Message Viewer.
later_known: A later message for this encounter is on Shutter's record.
time_doubtful: Whether the event time is true: an event in this encounter's order can't have happened then.
bed_occupied: The receiver reported the requested bed as occupied.
document_asked: File this document against the patient and episode named here.
result_asked: File this report against the patient and order named here.
attempted: Shutter sent this and got no answer.

manual_compare.where: The encounter's details, then its movement history.

present: It shows what the message asked
A person's observation that fits. It doesn't show that this message caused it.
absent: Nothing of this movement
Unresolved: it may be missing, or may still arrive. Correct it only by the site's agreed procedure; this alone doesn't authorise a resend.
different: A different or later placement
Read the movement history in time order before correcting anything.
cannot_tell: No encounter, several, or conflicting identity
Stop and resolve the identity first.

unknown: Whether the original can still arrive.
Without a movement history, a current placement doesn't show what became of this message.

later_movement.note: This movement belongs at its own time, not necessarily as the current placement. Never move the patient back to make this message true.
later_movement.where: The current placement and the movement history, including the later movement.

present: This movement is in the history at its time
It fits this message arriving or being entered another way. It doesn't show which.
absent: This movement is missing from the history
At a current-state receiver, a correct later placement may be enough for manual handling. At a history-of-record receiver the gap can still need correcting.
different: The placement differs from both
Read the history in time order before correcting anything.
cannot_tell: No history you can see
The current placement may be known while this message's fate stays unknown.

unknown: Whether the original can still arrive.

already_applied.note: The receiver's own receipt or history names this operation.
already_applied.where: The encounter and the recorded event at the receiver.

present: The screen matches
A person's observation that supports the receiver's record. Keep the two apart.
absent: The event isn't on the screen
Investigate: the screen and the record disagree. This doesn't authorise a resend.
different: The screen contradicts it
Investigate. Don't discard the receipt, and this doesn't authorise a resend.
cannot_tell: You can't tell
Keep the case stopped and escalate.

unknown: Whether anything changed at the receiver after that read.

refusal.note: This card shows no other patient's details: see the receiver's own screens.
refusal.where: Placement details and the site's bed or occupancy view.
compare: What the occupancy view shows now

present: The patient is in the requested place
A person's observation that fits. It doesn't show that this message caused it.
absent: The place is now free
That alone doesn't authorise the old move: check that it still applies.
different: It is still occupied
Unresolved. Follow the site's bed procedure.
cannot_tell: You can't tell
Keep the case stopped and escalate.

unknown: Why the receiver refused, beyond what it said.

identity_or_time.note: Only the fields Shutter could read reliably are shown as read.
identity_or_time.where: The source's registration or message, then a patient and episode search at the receiver.

present: One clear match
Compare it with the message, then resolve the mapping or the time at the source.
absent: No match
Don't create an encounter. Resolve the identity or the mapping first.
different: Several, or conflicting
Don't guess which record was meant. Resolve the identity first.
cannot_tell: The time can't be settled
Ask the source which time is right before correcting anything.

unknown: Which record or time the message meant.

uncertain.where: The queue or message trace, the receiver's event history, and any receipt or application audit you can see.

present: The screen shows it
This doesn't show the attempt has finished, or that this attempt made it.
absent: The screen doesn't show it
This doesn't show that it can't arrive later.
different: Something different
Read the history in time order before correcting anything.
cannot_tell: You can't tell
Keep the case stopped and escalate.

unknown: Whether the attempt was applied, or still can be.

history_correction.note: Two things, kept apart: this missing movement at its own time, and the later placement, which stays.
history_correction.where: The movement history, and the receiver's approved route for correcting history.
compare: This movement's ward, bed and time

present: This movement is in the history
Nothing is missing on this screen. Report what you saw.
absent: It is missing
Correct the history by the receiver's own route, keeping the current placement.
different: The history differs
Read it in time order before correcting anything.
cannot_tell: You can't see the history
Ask the receiver's team. This card doesn't know their procedure.

unknown: Whether the original can still arrive.

document.where: The document list, and the rejected or unfiled queue if the site uses one.

present: Filed against the right record, and it opens
A person's report that it was handled. A matching title alone is weak.
absent: Missing
Unresolved. Don't re-enter it while the original may still arrive.
different: Unreadable, duplicated or on another record
Unresolved: that isn't a successful filing.
cannot_tell: You can't tell
Open the original in the source's Message Viewer, and escalate.

unknown: Whether this document reached the receiver.
Whether the original can still arrive.

result.where: The patient's report list, and the rejected or unfiled queue if the site uses one.

present: Filed against the right record, and it opens
A person's report that it was handled. A matching test name alone is weak.
absent: Missing
Unresolved. Don't re-enter it while the original may still arrive.
different: Unreadable, duplicated or on another record
Unresolved: that isn't a successful filing.
cannot_tell: You can't tell
Open the original in the source's Message Viewer, and escalate.

unknown: Whether this report reached the receiver.
Whether the original can still arrive.

withheld.note: Shutter never sends this by itself.
withheld.where: The site's identity or cancellation procedure.

present: Already done by hand
A person owns the decision. This card neither approves it nor proves its effect.
absent: Not done
A person decides whether to apply it, in the systems concerned.
different: Something else was done
Check the records concerned, and escalate.
cannot_tell: You can't tell
Keep the case stopped and escalate.

unknown: The effect of this operation at the receiver.

other_message.where: The source's Message Viewer, then the receiver.

present: You find it at the receiver
A person's report. It doesn't show that this message caused it.
absent: You don't
Unresolved. Don't re-enter it while the original may still arrive.
different: Something different
Check the original before correcting anything.
cannot_tell: You can't tell
Keep the case stopped and escalate.

unknown: What this message did at the receiver.
